description: Fetch one transaction by its GraphQL global ID (the opaque `id` returned by braintree_search_transactions, NOT the short legacy id). Uses the GraphQL `node` query. Returns amount, status, timestamps, order id, and the linked customer.

id.description: GraphQL global transaction ID (opaque, base64-looking), e.g. from a search result's `node.id`.

name: braintree_find_transaction
title: Find a transaction
